typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	AdhocRun as boolean (),
	BEGIN_DT as timestamp (),
	BEGIN_DT_OUT as timestamp (),
	Email_Recipients as string (),
	END_DT as timestamp (),
	END_DT_OUT as timestamp (),
	FileLocation as string (),
	FileName as string (),
	FileName_Prefix as string (),
	GRGR_CK as string (),
	ID_Number as integer (),
	MarketName as string (),
	OutputPath as string (),
	Rept_Begin_Day as integer (),
	RowCount_DailyAuth as integer (),
	Run_Type as string (),
	SendToMindoulaOutput as string (),
	StoredProcName as string ()
}

source(output(
		ResultSet as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT ResultSet = CAST(CONCAT(UNIQUE_MEMBER_IDENTIFIER,\'|\',PREAUTHORIZATION_ID,\'|\',LAST_NAME,\'|\',FIRST_NAME,\'|\',MIDDLE_INIT,\'|\',DOB,\'|\',GENDER,\'|\',RACE_ETHNICITY,\'|\',PRIMARY_LANGUAGE,\'|\',MARITAL_STATUS,\'|\', 								  RESIDENT_ADDRESS,\'|\',CITY,\'|\',STATE,\'|\',ZIP_CODE,\'|\',COUNTY,\'|\',PHONE_NUMBER,\'|\',EMAIL_ADDRESS,\'|\',ADMISSION_DATE,\'|\',EXPECTED_DISCHARGE_DATE,\'|\',DISCHARGE_DATE,\'|\',  							      ADMITTING_DIAGNOSIS,\'|\',CURRENT_TREATING_PHYSICIAN_NPI,\'|\',FACILITY_NPI,\'|\',FACILITY_NAME) AS VARCHAR(MAX)) 		FROM EXTRACT.MINDOULA_STAGE_DAILY_AUTH_CENSUS WHERE (ROW_INDICATOR = \'HEADER\' OR GRGR_CK = ?) 		ORDER BY ROW_INDICATOR DESC',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> GetDailyAuthData
GetDailyAuthData sink(input(
		ResultSet as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		ResultSet)) ~> DailyAuthFiletoOutbound
